messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
a faint new vibration appears under load while you are handling A belt-driven feeder beside a noisy machine. You have only a few minutes before someone else needs it. How do you approach it?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R001", "response": "I stop with the belt under my finger. the vibration comes from the feed. I put my hand on the bench and leave the feeder beside it. the next thing I know, the machine clicks. I leave the vibration beside you."}, {"id": "R002", "response": "i turn the feeder with my hand and mark the slack with chalk. i run my thumb along the belt, then stop when the vibration clears. if it comes back, i will tighten the slack and mark the feeder again."}, {"id": "R003", "response": "i lift the feeder with my thumbnail and listen to the vibration. then i move the feeder closer to the machine, but not yet. the machine makes a soft click, so i keep my thumbnail beside it. the vibration stays under the feeder. i wait until the feeder stops."}, {"id": "R004", "response": "I rub my palm and touch the vibration with my thumbnail. \"quiet under load,\" I say. I lift the feeder close, scrape once, and look at the sound. I say no. I mark the belt with my thumbnail and try once more."}, {"id": "R005", "response": "I crouch and rub the seed tin with my claw. \"The vibration is here.\" I put the feeder beside the seed. \"The machine has one. I want the seed.\" I move the tin closer, then stop. The feeder moves. I put the tin back where I found it. \"The vibration stays.\""}, {"id": "R006", "response": "I tap the feeder once and listen. I lift the belt once, then again, and place it beside the machine. I tighten the handle once and leave the lever seated."}, {"id": "R007", "response": "i move the feeder with the belt-driven one, then stop with the one that was not there. i keep my fingers on the loose side of the feeder, not touching it yet. if the vibration comes again, i leave it and wait for the other one to finish."}, {"id": "R008", "response": "I keep the feeder beside the machine and count the vibration twice. I tap the belt with my heel, then push it away with my hand. I keep the old belt turned until the new one catches. I leave the old one seated and test the old one by slipping a folded cloth over the feeder."}, {"id": "R009", "response": "I put the feeder on the bench and rub the belt once. I move the belt slowly, then try the vibration under the bench. If it still catches, I leave it beside the machine and try once more."}, {"id": "R010", "response": "the vibration comes back with a louder tick. i put my hand on the feeder, then stop. “wait, i need that,” i say, though i keep the tick running. “it goes faster under the machine.” the machine taps again."}, {"id": "R011", "response": "i tap the belt with my greasy thumb. “new,” i say. i move the feeder closer, then stop. i tap the other machine with a rusted bolt, then leave the feeder in my palm. “not the same vibration,” i say."}, {"id": "R012", "response": "i leave the vibration visible under load and tap the belt with my knuckle. if it still catches, i leave the feeder beside it and mark the new catch with grease. i keep the new vibration in a pencil mark instead of marking it with a pencil-on-paper."}]
